worldcombat.skill.aquatail.summary: Swing the tail into an arc of water that presses forward: the crest advances from point-blank out to its reach, everyone it catches takes contact damage, is shoved away from the caster and stays drenched for a while. Fire and burns on those it hits are put out. The wave travels, so stepping out of the arc or backing past the crest dodges it.
worldcombat.skill.aquatail.use.0: Sweep the people in front with an advancing water wall
worldcombat.skill.aquatail.use.1: Shove a foe that is right in your face away with its footing
worldcombat.skill.aquatail.use.2: Put out a target's fire and burn with one wave
worldcombat.skill.aquatail.description.0: The wave deals %1$s contact damage and shoves the target %2$s blocks away from the caster.
worldcombat.skill.aquatail.description.1: The wave opens %1$s degrees and presses out to %2$s blocks, fading to %3$s of full power at the edge.
worldcombat.skill.aquatail.description.2: The crest advances in %1$s beats from point-blank to its reach; more beats means a slower wave, and stepping out of the arc or backing past the crest dodges it.
worldcombat.skill.aquatail.description.3: Drench the target for %1$s on hit.
worldcombat.skill.aquatail.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.aquatail.growth.0: From level %1$s the wave rises to %2$s and shoves %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.aquatail.growth.1: From level %1$s the wave rises to %2$s over %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.aquatail.growth.2: From level %1$s the wave rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.aquatail.preference.he: On: power ×1.12 and shove ×1.2, but one more advance beat (a slower, more avoidable wave), wind-up +2 ticks and cooldown +4 ticks. Off: a faster wave that lands before the foe steps out of the arc.
worldcombat.skill.aquatail.preference.ai: Beyond this distance the companion closes in before swinging. Larger values let it start a wave from further out.
On: the closer a target is, the higher it is prioritised, shoving whoever is on top of the companion away with its footing. Off: it sorts like an ordinary melee attack.
